name: geppio
description: GeppIO — a local desktop workbench, Windows first.

scripts.lint: eslint src tools tests examples electron.vite.config.ts
scripts.check: pnpm check:repo && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm plugins:build && pnpm build
scripts.test:plugin-package: pnpm build && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/plugin-package.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/plugin-package-smoke.ts
scripts.test:desktop: pnpm test:essentials && pnpm test:time-tracker && pnpm test:maximize && pnpm test:alignment && pnpm test:groups && pnpm test:edit-lock && node --experimental-strip-types tools/demo-retirement-smoke.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/identity-smoke.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/desktop-smoke.ts && pnpm test:workbench && pnpm test:presentations
scripts.test:documents: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/documents.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/document-smoke.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/multi-document-smoke.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/multi-document-smoke.ts --scale125 && node --experimental-strip-types tools/multi-document-smoke.ts --dev
scripts.test:workspace: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/workspace.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/workspace-smoke.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/workspace-smoke.ts --scale125 && node --experimental-strip-types tools/workspace-smoke.ts --dev
scripts.test:presentations: node --experimental-strip-types tools/presentation-smoke.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/real-presentation-smoke.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/real-presentation-smoke.ts --scale125
scripts.test:workbench: node --experimental-strip-types tools/workbench-smoke.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/workbench-organization-smoke.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/workbench-plugins-smoke.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/workbench-corrections-smoke.ts
scripts.test:plugin-dev: pnpm plugins:build && pnpm build && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/plugin-dev.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/plugin-dev-smoke.ts
scripts.test:git: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/git.test.ts tests/git-compatibility.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/git-smoke.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/git-smoke.ts --scale125 && node --experimental-strip-types tools/git-smoke.ts --dev
scripts.test:monaco: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/monaco.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/monaco-smoke.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/monaco-smoke.ts --scale125 && node --experimental-strip-types tools/monaco-smoke.ts --dev
